package com.x.test;
import org.junit.Assume;

import org.testng.SkipException;
import static org.junit.Assume.assumeTrue;
public class BGammaTest {
  @Test
  public void a() { assumeTrue(false); assertEquals(1, compute()); }

  public void b() { Assume.assumeTrue(false); }

  public void c() { assumeFalse(true); }

    throw new org.testng.SkipException("not yet");
  }
